purpose: Brewing graph — methods and variables for educational Steepleaf pages.

methods.label: Western
methods.description: Larger vessel, longer steep, fewer infusions.

methods.label: Gongfu
methods.description: Small vessel, short steeps, many infusions; attentive leaf expansion.

methods.label: Grandpa
methods.description: Leaves stay in the cup; top up with water as you drink.

methods.label: Cold Brew
methods.description: Long cold infusion; soft extraction, low bitterness.

methods.label: Matcha
methods.description: Whisked powdered tea; full leaf consumption.

methods.label: Travel
methods.description: Simple thermos or bottle brew when away from a tray.

methods.label: Competition
methods.description: Protocol-driven evaluation brew for cupping or contests.

waterProfiles.label: Soft mineral
waterProfiles.notes: Gentle extraction; good for delicate greens.

waterProfiles.label: Balanced
waterProfiles.notes: Everyday profile for most oolongs and blacks.

waterProfiles.label: Higher mineral
waterProfiles.notes: Can amplify body; watch bitterness on greens.
